## Summary

**Selected candidate: `candidate_01`** (derived from the supplied `seed` proposal via one revision).

**Review performed:**
- Listed all 6 supplied originals (1f_view, 2f_view, North/South/East/West elevations) and inspected the seed's saved geometry (14 spaces, 29 openings across F1/F2).
- Rebuilt outer-wall pixel calibrations directly from each drawing's own gray-wall outline and matched them to the drawings' explicit 15000×8000mm (plan) and 6600mm (elevation) dimension chains — anchors were taken from wall geometry, not fitted to the candidate's openings.
- Used `overlay_candidate` to project the seed's F1 and F2 plans onto `1f_view.png`/`2f_view.png`: every partition wall, corridor, and door/window position aligned to the original ink with no visible offset. Confirmed with `check_source_space_relation`-style visual inspection (e.g., the two F2 conference rooms each have their own independent door into the corridor, not a shared door — verified by zooming the original).
- Used `view_elevation_candidate` to project the seed's opening heights onto all four original elevations (North, South, East, West): all 15 windows and both exterior doors matched their drawn outlines closely.
- Read the explicit vertical dimension-chain labels on the elevations (800/1800/1000mm for F2 windows, 400/1600/1000mm for typical F1 windows, 900/600/1500mm for the small south window) and recorded/adopted three evidence-backed claims, then applied them via `revise_bim` to snap all 15 window heights to these exact measured values (differences from the seed were only 7–12mm, i.e. rounding, not real errors).
- Re-checked `check_openings(heights_only=true)`: image-evidence-linked coverage rose from 0/29 to 15/29 (all windows now linked); geometry validation still `pass` with 0 unsupported/unbuilt openings.

**Discrepancies found:** none requiring partition or connectivity changes — the seed's spatial layout, doors, and window positions were already faithful to the drawings. Only the window-height precision was tightened using explicit dimension-chain evidence.

**Left unresolved (honest limitations):**
- The two exterior door heights (F1:D7 west, F1:D8 south) and all 12 interior corridor doors remain a 2.1m *assumption* — no elevation gives an explicit door-height dimension label (only widths are labeled), and interior partitions aren't elevated at all, so these can't be claim-linked from the supplied drawings.
- Room-use roles (`room_use_review`) remain unrecorded for all 14 spaces — out of this review's scope (geometry/openings only), left as-is per task scope.
- The west-facade porch recess and south-wall corner notch remain simplified to flush walls with single doors (pre-existing, documented assumption from the seed).
- No stair/vertical circulation is shown in the source drawings between F1/F2, so none is modeled.
- Pixel-to-world calibration for both plan and elevation overlays was my own choice from wall/dimension geometry, not independently verified beyond the strong visual match achieved.
- A cosmetic `replace_note` call failed (duplicate note text in the seed) and was skipped — it did not affect geometry, only a text tidy-up.
